name: Opposed Agendas
unlocks: Castalia passage (after Trouble at the Gate)

meals.note: Fianna needs Support 3 well before Renown 8 (Ch 10). Meals 2 and 3: seat whoever of Seteth, Ninae or Mikaela is still short of Support 3, else Sirocco.

weekly.text: Feed every mount at the Stable daily, the two Meganius too once you catch them

missables.text: Talk to Alexandra for Help My Feelings Take Wing before the free time ends
Take the Jurah Carving to Collapsed Fort for Hidden Memories (from Ch 5) if it's still open
Watch Ninae and Cai's support conversations at the Inn as soon as each one unlocks
missables.lose: Some chains are story-timed and lock if you wait

note.text: Finish any Ch 6 Specialty exam still open: Ultand's Shaman and Noctula's Pugilist often land here
detail: Renown 6 joiners arrive at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class: no exam unless one arrives in another class.
Seteth and Ninae take their Specialty exams in Ch 8, at Lv 20.

buy.text: Buy several Tales of Adventure (270G) at Alecto: Ninae's weekly gift
detail: Seteth, Mikaela, Nydine and Noctula love it too.

buy.text: Megaira Armory: a [[item:Ridersbane]] for Cai and a [[item:Shielding Axe]] for Seteth
detail: The Ridersbane goes to Seteth later; the Shielding Axe to Jasmine.
Its Da Mina Spear and Da Mina Axe count toward Its Name Is Da Mina (Ch 10 wants 2).

buy.text: Consider a [[item:Cleansing Blade]] from Vandahl for the Underworld maps

barter.for: Seteth (a second one for Peppe in Ch 10, or an Archer's Ring)

assign.why: The one near the start of the Ch 7 battle map

recruits.action: Take his short quest, go to the marker and report back
recruits.when: Late Ch 7; not there by 7/9 means Ch 8
detail: He brings the Spear of Assal (Mt 7, Wt 8): weaker and heavier than an Iron Spear, so it goes to storage.

recruits.action: Hand over 1× [[gather:Paradise Fish]] from [[place:Lake Brontes]] (Saveilon, past Valhalla Mine)
recruits.when: Late Ch 7; not there by 7/9 means Ch 8
Late Ch 7; not there by 7/9 means Ch 8

prep.text: Majide or Mikaela not recruited yet? Their rows are in Ch 6 (Renown 5 often lands here)
Keep Fianna's Support rising: she needs Support 3 by Renown 8 (Ch 10)

route.note: Do it first: it unlocks carriages
Opens the passage to Castalia: Dione Fort and the Ch 8 Pegasus

sub.note: Grab the Lake Brontes statue on the Saveilon trip. Its Flying Manual goes to Seteth for Dragoon
Tempest Bow: Peter while he's an Archer, then Mikaela
Starts a 3-part chain: Another Challenge (Ch 9), One Last Challenge (Ch 10)
Uses the Jyoppa from Defeat Aguino's Thieves

explore.text: Go to Saveilon this chapter: Ninae's fish, the Alecto shopping and two mounts in one trip
detail: Fish two [[gather:Paradise Fish]] at Lake Brontes: one for Ninae, one for Nydine's Giant's Ring.
Can't reach Saveilon yet? Do all of it on Castor's Renown 7 trip in late Ch 8; Ninae then joins in Ch 8.

explore.text: Catch Seteth's [[mount:Meganius]] and Nydine's [[mount:Red Meganius]] at [[place:Axion Gorge]]
detail: Nydine's is for Part II. Roll for Paired Run: hard save on the animal tile before you set the lure.

explore.text: [[place:Dione Fort]] (Lv 18, Castalia): Flying Manual for Seteth, Hexlock Shield for Jasmine
detail: Opens after Trouble at the Gate.
Ninae takes the Hexlock barter; Cai keeps the lighter Talisman Shield (Dragonbone Tangle is closed in Part I).

explore.text: [[place:Cindered Road Cave]] (Lv 22, Solidus): Flying Manual for Nydine, Conflagrant Gem as a spare
detail: The Gem is an optional swap for Peter's Archer's Ring.

explore.text: [[place:Rubess Forest]] (Lv 9, Melias): Riding Manual for Peter, Healing Staff for Ninae, Lucky Coin
detail: Riding Manual: Peter first, then Fianna or Mikaela. Fianna's staff comes from Orchel's Paralogue (Ch 11).
Also a good support run for this week's meal pairs.

explore.text: [[place:Masked Woods]] (Lv 15, Melias): Heavy-Armor Manual for Jasmine (Heavy D)
[[place:Shadowy Cave]] (Lv 12, Lambath): Magic Manuals for Sirocco, Killing Edge for Guzran
detail: It may need Dietrich's Paralogue first.

explore.text: [[place:Nemea Cavern]] (Lv 30, Pasithea): second Heavy-Armor Manual and a Hammer for Jasmine
Plant 30 Melara, Shaktoh or Usamos for the Ch 8 crop quest
detail: Plus 3 Shaktoh (Noctula's Phantom Ring) and 6 Melara (Ultand's Iron Gauntlets).

tips.text: Grab the Cleansing Blade near the start for Guzran, and bring armor-piercing weapons
Split up and stay out of ballista range (check it with ZL)
Inyoni fires a long-range arrow every third turn: count turns before you step into range
It ends with an Event Clash: give Cai a [[item:Linking Rock]]
